concerns.text: FR-009 leaves the primary structural density threshold as a '[deferred]' placeholder, yet the Assumptions section declares a primary threshold of 15 % and FR-016 sweeps only 10 %, 20 % and 30 %. The spec never defines a concrete primary structural threshold, creating a contradiction between requirement and design.

SC-006 expects a `data_availability_report.txt` file, while FR-019 specifies the report name as `data_completeness_report.txt`. This mismatch makes it unclear which artifact the success criterion refers to, violating internal consistency of naming.
